title: Navalia：通过可验证任务合成与长程后训练推进协作智能体
summary: Navalia提出结合可验证任务合成与长程后训练的协作智能体框架，以企业财报为数据源构建带可追溯证据和真实数据依赖的分析任务，经独立LLM审查与程序化校验后用于轨迹收集、冷启动SFT和强化学习，在五个基准上均优于基座模型。
summary_en: Navalia is a framework for Cowork Agents that combines verifiable task synthesis with long-horizon post-training. Using corporate financial reports, it builds analytical tasks with traceable evidence and real data dependencies, verifies them via independent LLM review and programmatic checks, then applies trajectory collection, cold-start SFT, and RL. Initialized from Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, it consistently outperforms the base model on five benchmarks.
